response.sql: WITH artifact_total AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS total FROM scanfeatures), unit_shares AS (SELECT sf.zoneref, sf.articount, CAST(sf.articount AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(t.total, 0) AS share FROM scanfeatures AS sf CROSS JOIN artifact_total AS t), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM unit_shares) SELECT u.zoneref AS site_code, u.articount AS artifact_count, u.share, u.share - a.value AS difference_from_average FROM unit_shares AS u CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE a.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A zero overall artifact total makes shares undefined, so the query returns no rows.
